name: Jhunjhunu

queries.query: Jhunjhunu Rajasthan official cadastral parcel map land records GIS
queries.result: Official results identified Rajasthan's BhuNaksha cadastral viewer, the Rajdharaa Urban GIS portal with district/tehsil/village/khasra search, the Apna Khata land-record service, and the Board of Revenue cadastral-map digitization program. The results establish public first-party cadastral/map services but did not provide an anonymous Jhunjhunu parcel geometry response.

queries.query: झुंझुनूं राजस्थान आधिकारिक भू नक्शा खसरा नक्शा भूमि अभिलेख GIS
queries.result: आधिकारिक हिंदी परिणामों में राजस्थान भू-नक्शा, अपना खाता, राजधरा अर्बन GIS, तथा राजस्व विभाग का कैडस्ट्रल मैप डिजिटलीकरण कार्यक्रम मिला। झुंझुनूं के लिए जिला-विशिष्ट राजस्व अधिसूचना भी मिली। किसी अनाम सार्वजनिक अनुरोध से झुंझुनूं का पार्सल ज्यामिति उत्तर नहीं मिला।

registryEvidence.custodian: Rajasthan Revenue Department / Board of Revenue, with NIC BhuNaksha and Rajdharaa public GIS services
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official state cadastral viewer and urban GIS expose cadastral/khasra workflows that include district, tehsil and village selection; the Jhunjhunu notification evidences the district revenue administration. This is registry/map-service evidence, not proof of complete citywide parcel coverage or an open download API.

parcelDiscovery.source: NIC BhuNaksha Rajasthan; Rajdharaa Urban GIS
parcelDiscovery.note: No parcel feature, native identifier, schema response or CRS was retained because the public endpoints did not return a bounded anonymous feature response. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted or used as an absence test.

uncertainty: GET https://www.bhunaksha.rajasthan.gov.in/georef_gmaps.html timed out after 20 seconds with normal TLS verification; no certificate exception was used.

The documented BhuNaksha REST menu routes were attempted as bounded anonymous requests; they timed out before returning a response. A diagnostic retry used curl's -k flag but was not used as evidence and produced no response; no data was retained from it.

GET https://gis.rajasthan.gov.in/citizenudh/index returned HTTP 404 ('The page you requested was removed'); the indexed portal page documents the same official service but no live API configuration was recovered.
A map extent miss, timeout, removed page, or unusable viewer is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, certificate, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission; runtime remains held pending independent serial adapter qualification.
